coverage.title: Research coverage & discovery
coverage.help: Current collection evidence, not signal quality or proof of profitability.
coverage.scope: Active narrative links or recent qualified social candidates: {scanned} of {total} tokens inspected.
coverage.limits: Price freshness: 15 minutes. Holder/risk freshness: 60 minutes. A fresh risk row is not a safety verdict. The current scan is capped at 2,000 tokens; it does not measure all market activity.
coverage.counterNote: Counters sum repeated scan attempts, not unique tokens or missed calls. Evidence rejections are not guaranteed alerts. UTC-day totals may cover only part of the day; failed runs are not counted. Inspect worker health below for failures and missing consumers. No history is backfilled. Collection budgets remain 150 tokens and 18 info calls per market cycle.

smartResearch.title: Wallet-flow research
smartResearch.help: Follow observed token destinations and inspect the evidence behind each wallet. Qualification is an unvalidated research rule, not proof of future profits.
smartResearch.noFlows: No qualifying wallet-flow observations have been recorded.
smartResearch.outcomeNote: Returns are gross token-price changes from the frozen publication observation, not wallet PnL or executable returns. SELL observations also show the token return, not short-trade profit. Missing horizons stay unknown.
smartResearch.emergingNote: Repeated early buyers in the sampled 48-hour scan. This is not a profitability ranking. These wallets are not automatically tracked or admitted to signals.
smartResearch.adminHelp: Operator review and evidence qualification are separate. Approval cannot bypass missing history, sample size or freshness checks.
smartResearch.saved: Review saved. Qualification still depends on current evidence.
smartResearch.saveError: Review was not saved. Refresh the evidence and try again.
smartResearch.enabled: Research publication configured on this API process.
smartResearch.disabled: Research publication is disabled on this API process. Worker configuration must match at deployment.
smartResearch.candidateNote: Approving a discovery candidate adds it to tracking as provisional. Research qualification requires a separate review and sufficient current history.

brief.timingNote: Pool creation and token creation are different events. Neither is Narrax's first detection time or proof that a token is early. The 1h change describes the provider's window, not performance since a radar call.
brief.holdersMissing: No holder snapshot. Concentration is unknown.

brief.narrativesMissing: No recorded narrative links. The reason for any price move is unknown.

pm.title: Manual paper trading
pm.help: Practice with virtual SOL. These controls never sign, send transactions or spend wallet funds. Every order needs a review and confirmation.
pm.paperRequired: Your account must be in PAPER mode to place orders. Use the account mode control above; nothing switches automatically.
pm.noQuotes: Paper trading is unavailable: the server has no quote provider configured.
pm.paused: Paper trading is paused by your existing trading controls.
pm.permission: Buys require your existing trading permission. Paper exits do not enable or change that permission.
pm.modeHelp: Choose Paper to allow simulated fills, or Shadow to record activity without fills. This changes only your own account, and only when you pick it.
pm.entriesHelp: Paper buys use your existing trading permission, which is currently off. Enabling it here applies to your own account only; while the account is in Paper mode, entries are simulations.
pm.setupError: The account change could not be saved. Your mode and trading permission were left unchanged.
pm.evidence: Buys require fresh, server-recorded BUY evidence and existing governor checks. Missing or stale inputs block the order. No confidence, balance or quote is guessed.
pm.clamped: Risk limits reduced {requested} SOL to {approved} SOL. Only the approved size will be simulated.
pm.reviewNote: Confirmation fetches a fresh quote and checks permissions, balances and limits again. A changed position, size or worse-than-reviewed quote requires a new review. Paper fees and USD fill prices are approximations, not live execution costs.
pm.expired: This review expired. Cancel and request a new review. If the submission result is unclear, retry the same confirmation instead.
pm.ack: I understand this is a simulated order using virtual SOL.
pm.uncertain: The submission result is unclear. Retry this same confirmation to retrieve its result safely; do not create a new order.
pm.filled: Simulated order filled. No wallet funds were used. Order:
pm.errorGeneric: The paper order could not be completed. Check the reason below and review again. Your trading permissions and limits have not been changed.
pm.realReadOnly: Live positions remain read-only. Manual controls are available only for the paper account.

errors.PAPER_REVIEW_CHANGED: The position, quote or approved size changed. Cancel and review the order again.
errors.PAPER_PREVIEW_EXPIRED: The review expired. Request a new review.
errors.AI_ACCESS_DISABLED: Existing trading permission is off or expired. No paper buy was filled.
errors.AGENT_PAUSED: Your existing trading controls are paused.
errors.DUPLICATE_WINDOW: A matching order was submitted recently. Check your trades before trying again.
errors.COOLDOWN_ACTIVE: This token is still within the trading cooldown.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The reviewed order or eligible paper position was not found for your account.

accessCard.preview: The market snapshot above is open to every signed-in member. Your portfolio and account settings are always available.

featureAccess.logging: Log denied feature access (permissions remain enforced)
featureAccess.title: Feature access by tier
featureAccess.help: Choose the minimum level for each research feature. Higher levels inherit lower-level features. Agent access is separate: its tools can only read features the user is allowed to use.
featureAccess.enforcement: Feature permissions are always enforced, including direct URLs, API requests and Agent tools. Existing minimum membership-age rules are preserved; they require a qualifying Pro membership, even if the level is lowered.
featureAccess.invalid: Stored feature settings are invalid. Nothing can be saved here until an operator repairs them.
featureAccess.age: Existing minimum Pro membership age: {hours} hours (preserved)

dataHealth.title: Data health
dataHealth.help: Read-only ingestion, coverage and worker diagnostics. Updates every 30 seconds. Unknown evidence is never treated as healthy.
dataHealth.cached: Showing the last successful snapshot; refresh failed.
dataHealth.receipt: Last delivery: {items} transactions · {parsed} parsed swaps · {queued} queued · {skipped} unsupported.
dataHealth.webhookNote: Sync reports provider configuration, not endpoint reachability. Empty probes do not count as deliveries. Quiet wallets can produce no events; older deliveries may predate this telemetry.
dataHealth.walletNote: Profiles require at least five matched buy/sell closes, not a day of tracking. Scores describe stored samples, not verified profitability or complete history.
dataHealth.historyCapped: {count} wallets reached their historical scan limit; cost basis may be incomplete.
dataHealth.marketNote: Scanned {scanned} of {total} non-blacklisted tokens. A source-linked reading older than 15 minutes is stale; unknown/imported rows are not trusted. Inactive or unsupported tokens may have no market reading.
dataHealth.analysisNote: Candidates are normally considered within one hour and still subject to token cooldown, per-run limits and budget. Candidate counts are not a promise of analysis. Analysis is research, not a trading instruction.
dataHealth.workerNote: Failure counts include retained historical jobs, even after recovery. Missing retained timestamps do not prove a worker is stopped. Worker counts and backlog are current observations.
dataHealth.unknownIssue: An unrecognized diagnostic was reported; refresh or review server diagnostics.
dataHealth.noIssues: No issues detected in this snapshot. This is not proof of complete ingestion or provider availability.

issues.AI_MODEL_PLACEHOLDER: A configured AI model is empty or a placeholder (gpt-6-luna / gpt-6-sol) and will be rejected by the provider. Change the model names in Admin AI settings; saved ai.models settings override AI_MODEL_ID.
issues.AI_RUN_SKIPPED: The last retained analysis run was skipped. Check its reason: no_provider means the worker lacks a provider key; disabled means analysis was off; budget means its daily allowance was exhausted. Restart workers with the correct environment if needed.
issues.QUEUES_UNAVAILABLE: Queue diagnostics are unavailable. Check Redis and API connectivity before interpreting missing results.
issues.WORKER_MISSING: A configured queue has no connected worker. Start the full pipeline worker and check its startup logs.
issues.RETAINED_FAILURES: Some queues retain failed jobs. Compare the failure and completion timestamps: an old failure may already be recovered. Review worker logs before retrying anything.
issues.AI_PROVIDER_FAILURES: The latest retained analysis run reported provider failures. Check saved model IDs, provider access and worker logs; do not assume an analysis will arrive.
issues.PROVIDER_RATE_LIMIT: A latest retained collector run reported rate limiting. Reduce request pressure or wait for provider limits to reset; inspect worker logs.
issues.WEBHOOK_NOT_CONFIGURED: Wallet webhook configuration is incomplete. Configure Helius credentials, the public webhook URL and the shared secret, then restart API/workers.
issues.WEBHOOK_SYNC_UNKNOWN: No recent webhook-sync evidence is available (30-minute threshold). Check the wallet-sync worker; this does not independently prove delivery failure.
issues.WEBHOOK_SYNC_PROBLEM: The last webhook-sync attempt reported an error or disabled provider webhook. Check the endpoint and Helius dashboard before restoring delivery.
issues.NO_DELIVERY_EVIDENCE: No non-empty authenticated webhook delivery has been recorded by the new telemetry. This can mean quiet wallets, older unrecorded deliveries or a delivery problem; verify Helius delivery logs and public endpoint connectivity.
issues.DELIVERY_UNPARSED: The last non-empty delivery contained no supported swaps. Inspect provider payload coverage; token-to-token or ambiguous transactions are intentionally excluded.
issues.DELIVERY_STALE: No authenticated non-empty webhook delivery in over an hour. Wallets may be quiet; check the public endpoint or tunnel and Helius delivery logs. Successful webhook sync does not prove delivery works.
issues.DELIVERY_UNTRACKED: The last parsed delivery queued no tracked-wallet swaps. Check the address list and active tracked wallets.
issues.NO_WALLET_TRADES: No usable active-wallet trades are stored in the 30-day window. Check ingestion and consider a bounded history repair; waiting alone cannot create matched closes.
issues.WALLET_COMPUTATION_GAPS: Some scanned wallets lack a recent computation (45-minute threshold). Check the wallet-intelligence worker and refresh after a successful run.
issues.INSUFFICIENT_WALLET_HISTORY: Some tracked wallets have no profile. Inspect each wallet's matched closes and coverage; an absent profile is not automatically a worker failure.
issues.MARKET_COVERAGE_GAPS: Some scanned tokens have stale or unverified market readings. Check market collection and provider coverage; unsupported or inactive tokens can legitimately remain unavailable.
issues.TOKEN_NAMES_MISSING: Some tokens still have placeholder names. Check metadata collection; unavailable metadata stays unknown rather than being invented.
issues.AI_DISABLED: Opportunity analysis is switched off in saved settings.
issues.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: The analysis provider is not configured. Set the server-side provider key and restart workers; never put it in public web configuration.
issues.ANALYSIS_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: Today's analysis token budget is exhausted or zero. Review the budget in admin settings or wait for the next UTC day. Trading safeguards remain unchanged.

enhance.tradeSample: {buys} buys · {sells} sells · {unmatched} sells without a recorded buy.
enhance.historyRepair: Historical repair: {accepted} accepted swaps from {scanned} scanned transactions. Checked: {at}.
enhance.historyCapped: Scan limit reached; history and cost basis may be incomplete.
enhance.analysisCoverage: No analysis was saved for this record. Scheduled analysis normally considers scores of 50 or above recorded within the last hour, with a per-token cooldown. Provider availability and the daily budget also apply; waiting does not guarantee analysis for every record.
enhance.priceCoverage: Only source-linked price observations are shown. History builds as the collector runs; older unverified records are excluded. This is sampled market data, not an exchange candle feed.
enhance.priceCapped: Showing at most the latest 500 stored readings in this range.
enhance.noPriceHistory: No source-linked price observations in this range yet. Try a longer range or wait for the next collection.
enhance.priceLineNote: Lines connect recorded observations, not candles. Collection gaps over 20 minutes and pool switches are left disconnected.
enhance.eventCoverage: Collector observations and recorded assessments, newest first. These are not on-chain trade, liquidity-addition or mint events. Pool creation is a provider-reported timestamp.
enhance.noObservedEvents: No recorded observations are available yet.
enhance.issuerEvidence: Wallet identified as the signing mint authority in the token's initialization transaction. This is creator-associated evidence, not proof of developer identity. Related wallets are not included.
enhance.issuerUnknown: No verified original issuing wallet yet. Program-controlled authorities, incomplete history and unavailable RPC data remain unknown—not zero.
enhance.profileRequirement: You do not need to wait 30 days. Scores are recalculated every 15 minutes using the last 30 days of available trades, once there are at least 5 matched buy/sell closes. Open buys and sells without a recorded buy do not qualify. History coverage may be incomplete; a score does not prove profitability.
enhance.profileProgress: {closed} / {required} matched closes from {observed} trades in the last {days} days (lookback, not a waiting period). Last calculation: {at}.
enhance.invalidAddress: Invalid historical address; no chain lookup available
enhance.capBasis: Ranges include their endpoints and use reported market cap only. FDV substitutes and unknown valuations are excluded. Sorting applies across all matching results, not just this page.
enhance.ideasBody: Review recorded research ideas: the narrative behind a token, the model's assessment and the evidence you still need. Use Tokens to compare raw market data.
enhance.discoverBody: Start with a recorded token and its linked narrative.
enhance.evaluateBody: Inspect the score breakdown, bull and bear cases, and risks.
enhance.verifyBody: Check a separate source-backed quote before drawing conclusions.
enhance.ideaCoverage: Coverage: latest idea per token among the newest 500 records.
enhance.noIdeas: No recorded ideas are available for your account yet. Explore Tokens and Radar while the research pipeline collects evidence.
enhance.quoteSeparate: This quote is separate from the historical idea. A fresh price does not validate an old score or decision.
enhance.walletBody: Explore the tracked wallet directory, inspect recorded transactions and follow links to on-chain evidence. Newly tracked wallets appear while their profiles are being computed.
enhance.walletCoverage: Active tracked addresses only. Search and source filters apply to the entire directory; newest tracked first.
enhance.noWallets: No tracked wallets match. Clear your filters or ask an administrator to add addresses under tracked-wallet management. Activity appears after wallet ingestion is configured.
enhance.awaitingProfileBody: Waiting for wallet intelligence to compute a profile.
enhance.walletEvidence: Trade counts describe stored records, not verified profitability or complete chain history. Explorer links let you inspect transactions independently; rankings remain unverified.
enhance.walletDetailBody: Recorded activity, narrative exposure and available profile evidence for this tracked address.
enhance.scanCoverage: Scanned {count} stored trades in the last {days} days.
enhance.noNarrativeTrades: No narrative-linked trades in this scan.
enhance.noTransactions: No stored transactions match. Tracking begins when ingestion is active; this view does not invent or backfill trades.

trench.tokensBody: A source-backed Solana market scan. Compare liquidity, activity and pool age before opening a token.
trench.opportunitiesBody: Build a memecoin watchlist from observed market conditions. These are research candidates, not buy signals.
trench.walletBody: Inspect tracked addresses and the evidence behind their reputation. Separate observed activity from unverified rankings.
trench.coverage: DEX Screener snapshots, refreshed on a 5-minute schedule. Collection has a fixed 150-token budget per cycle, so many tokens have no recent snapshot. Rows without a matched source observation stay unverified; older matched observations are labeled last observed with their timestamp and are not current quotes. This is sampled Solana pool coverage, not every launch or a memecoin classification.
trench.noMarket: No source-linked market observations match this view. Check collector status or try another filter. Missing values are never replaced with unrelated history.
trench.turnoverNote: Volume / liquidity is 24h traded volume divided by current pool liquidity, not unique buying demand. High turnover can include bots or wash trading. Pool creation is a proxy, not token mint time. FDV is labeled when market cap is unavailable.
trench.historyNote: These retained records have no independently established live provenance and may include development/test history. Their prices, wallet rankings and model scores are not current signals. Records are retained for linked account and analysis history.
trench.walletEvidence: The stored wallet profiles do not yet establish a verified live performance history. Scores, win rates and PnL are hidden by default. Inspect the address on Solscan; a high score alone does not establish skill or independent buying.
trench.context: Market observations and social coverage are sampled. Check timestamps, valuation basis and source links. Historical wallet and AI scores are kept separate from the current market scan.

runtime.title: Runtime settings
runtime.help: Public sign-in configuration and extra browser origins. Changes are audited and propagate within 20 seconds; reload the page to use a new Privy app.
runtime.originsHelp: One exact HTTP(S) origin per line, no paths or wildcards. Environment origins always remain allowed.
runtime.override: Override failed or unreachable Privy check (audited; may break sign-in)
runtime.recovery: Changing apps creates different user identities; make your new user admin. For lockout recovery in the configured API terminal:
runtime.checked: The public key matches this Privy app. Nothing was saved.
runtime.saved: Runtime settings saved. Reload after at most 20 seconds; no web rebuild is needed.
runtime.mismatch: Privy does not publish this key for the App ID. Check both values or explicitly override the check.
runtime.unreachable: Privy could not be reached. Retry later or explicitly override the check.
runtime.invalid: Invalid settings. Use a valid App ID, a complete P-256 public PEM key, and exact browser origins.
runtime.unauthorized: Admin access is required. Sign in again with an admin account.
runtime.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and retry.
runtime.error: Runtime settings could not be loaded or saved. Please retry.

adminForbidden: This page is for admins only.
adminForbiddenHelp: Admin is set by the server environment, not by this page. An operator points ADMIN_PRIVY_USER_ID or ADMIN_EMAIL at your account, then you reload. Locally, npm run make-admin still works when neither is set.
adminEnvHint: Copy one of these values into ADMIN_PRIVY_USER_ID (account id) or ADMIN_EMAIL (email) in the server environment, then restart the API.
adminOpenHelp: Signed-in users with a verified wallet can join until the seat cap is reached.
adminDomainHelp: The exact web origin wallets are verified on. Local: http://localhost:4010
adminEnforceHelp: Off: every signed-in user sees all research. On: only users with access do.
adminShadow: Log access decisions while not enforcing
adminSaved: Saved. The public pages reflect this immediately.
adminWhitelistHelp: Find a person by wallet address, user id or Privy id. They must have signed in and verified a wallet first.
adminSearch: Wallet address, user id or Privy id
adminNoUser: No user found. They need to sign in once, then verify a wallet on the early access page.
adminNoWallets: No verified wallet yet. Access cannot be granted until they verify one.
adminErrForbidden: Your account is not an admin.
adminErrDisabled: Early access is turned off. Turn it on in settings first.
adminErrFull: All seats are taken. Raise the seat cap.
adminErrWallet: That user has not verified a wallet yet.
adminErrInvalid: Something in the form is not valid. Check the values and try again.
adminErrDomain: Set the wallet link domain first.
adminErrSession: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
adminErrRate: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

gateMethods: Use email, Google or a Solana wallet. Sign-in is handled by Privy.
gateReadOnly: Read-only research. Nothing here places a trade.
gateNoSeed: We never ask for your seed phrase.

notFound: This research record was not found
notFoundBody: It may no longer be available. Return to the list to choose another record.
timeout: Sign-in is taking longer than expected. Reload or return to access.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
noLive: Refresh to request a new snapshot. This view is not a live feed.
researchOnly: Research only. Scores and model recommendations are estimates, not trade instructions or predictions.
sourceLanguage: Research text is shown in the language returned by the source.
overviewTitle: A clearer view of the market.
overviewBody: Narratives, opportunities and your account activity in one research workspace.
radarBody: Explore lifecycle stage and score. Select a narrative to inspect its evidence.
opportunitiesBody: Compare the evidence, the uncertainty and the model’s reasoning. Recommendations do not execute trades.
tokensBody: Find a token by name, symbol or mint address.
rulesBrief: Generated from recorded facts using fixed rules.
name: Name
radarNote: Each marker is one narrative on this page; marker size is constant. Lifecycle stage is categorical, not elapsed time.
noRotation: No rotation detected in this window.
rotationNote: Describes past score changes, not a prediction. Thresholds are unvalidated starting values.
contextBody: Explore research and manage your access. Account trading controls belong to a later phase.
timelineGap: A full lifecycle timeline is not exposed by the current API.
ogNote: OG scores and creator relationships are estimates, not proof of origin.
creatorsCap: Only the first 50 related creators are shown.
noAnalysis: No analysis is available for this opportunity yet.
blacklistBody: This token is marked as blacklisted by the server.
historyGap: Historical candles and token event overlays are not exposed by the current API. Only the latest observation is shown; no price path or events are invented.
eventsGap: Event history is unavailable, not an empty or verified-safe event log.
noFlags: No flags recorded in this snapshot. This is not a safety guarantee.
chartSingle: A single recorded price is not a trend.
loadedPageOnly: Sorting applies to the current API page.
adminTiersHelp: The amounts people see on the site for each level. The membership gate itself is set on Wyntrax: set the same numbers on the matching Wyntrax membership token gates, or what users see will not match who gets in.
adminClosesHelp: After this time nobody new can join early access. Seats already held keep working. Leave empty for no end date.
adminAccessDaysHelp: How long a self-joined early-access seat lasts. Leave empty for seats that do not expire.
adminTiersOrder: Each level must ask for more tokens than the one below it.
adminTiersPreview: Shown to users as: Member {member}, Pro {pro} {symbol}
adminErrClosed: The early-access window has ended. Move the closing time later or clear it.
alertsBody: Notifications for you: new narratives, shifts and signals. Marking one read only changes your own list.

backtests.body: Replay evidence from saved historical research. Not live trading performance.
backtests.readOnly: Read-only saved reports. Opening this page does not run a backtest or change trading settings.
backtests.coverageMissing: History coverage was not recorded for this report.
backtests.noHistory: Insufficient stored history. Missing evidence is not a zero return or proof of safety.
backtests.coverageNote: Requested dates do not guarantee continuous coverage. Token counts and readings alone do not establish statistical sufficiency.
backtests.noFindings: No supported finding was recorded. This is not evidence of profitability.
backtests.noWarnings: No additional no-conclusion notes were recorded; this does not validate the strategy.
backtests.empty: No saved full backtest is available yet. An operator must generate and save a report from stored history. Returns are not estimated here.
backtests.limitationsBody: In-sample price replay, not actual fills or a forward test. Round-trip costs are assumptions; liquidity, slippage, missing prices and correlated tokens can materially worsen outcomes. Only stored price, liquidity, volume, momentum and exit-level history can be replayed. Historical narrative rules, wallet exits, holder concentration and developer activity remain unvalidated. Never use this report alone to raise risk limits.
backtests.adminOnly: Detailed reports and saved-run history are available to administrators only.
backtests.historyNote: Up to 50 most recent saved runs. Select one to load its detailed results; no new run is started.
backtests.generateHelp: Operator command (in the configured backend environment; generates and saves a report):
backtests.gates: Evidence gates: at least {sample} events and {tokens} distinct tokens per group. These starting gates are unvalidated, not a guarantee of independence.
backtests.returnsNote: Net price returns after the assumed cost, not realized P&L. Thin-sample estimates remain visible but do not support a conclusion. Intervals are 95% mean intervals; baseline differences are percentage points.
backtests.worstCase: Mean if all unknowns lose 100% + cost

pf.body: Your own positions, results, trades and wallets. Manual controls create simulated paper orders only, after review and confirmation. Live positions remain read-only; monitor readings are recommendations, never orders.
pf.noPositions: No open position is stored for this account. A paper position appears after a BUY decision in PAPER mode.
pf.monitorPending: The position monitor has not recorded a reading for this position.
pf.blind: No fresh price, so the price rules did not run.
pf.unavailable: {count, plural, one {# check could not run} other {# checks could not run}}
pf.monitorNote: Fixed rules over stored price, liquidity and volume. A reading is a recommendation, not an order, and not advice.
pf.sampleEnough: Enough closed positions for the interval to mean something.
pf.sampleThin: Too few closed positions for a reliable win rate. Treat this as an observation, not a result.
pf.truncated: The window is capped at the most recent trades, so totals cover only what was stored in range.
pf.noDaily: No realized trade is stored in this window.
pf.dailyCap: Showing the {shown} most recent days of {total}.
pf.equityEmpty: No portfolio snapshot is stored for this account and window. A snapshot is written only when every price and balance it needs is available.
pf.downsampled: The curve is downsampled for display. The values are stored readings, not interpolated.
pf.equityNote: Stored snapshots from {from} to {to}. A gap is a missing snapshot, not a flat line.
pf.equityChartLabel: Portfolio value in SOL across {count} stored readings, peak {peak} and latest {latest}.
pf.equitySingle: One stored reading is a point, not a trend.
pf.equityChartNote: Stored snapshots only. This line is not a forecast and not a price feed.
pf.exportFailed: The export could not be downloaded. Nothing was saved.
pf.exportNote: The export comes from the API's own audited endpoint, capped at 10,000 rows and logged. It is the only place per-trade fees and realized P&L appear.
pf.noTrades: No trade is stored for this account yet.
pf.walletsEmpty: No trading wallet is stored for this account yet.
pf.balancesUnavailable: Balance reads are not configured on this deployment. A missing balance stays unknown, never zero.
pf.walletNote: These are the account's own trading wallets, not the wallets linked for sign-in.

analyticsBody: What happened after past agent decisions. Small samples are labelled; none of this is a promise of future results.
agentBody: Ask the research assistant about narratives, tokens and signals. It explains data; it cannot trade.
settingsBody: Your display name, appearance and which alerts you receive.
smartMoneyBody: Tracked wallets ranked by score, with their recent 30-day record.
smartMoneyCaveat: Scores are model estimates from past activity, not advice. Cluster links are inferred and show a confidence.
smSortNote: Sorted by recorded score: wallets with a computed profile come first, and wallets without one keep their recency order. A score is a model estimate from past activity, not verified skill.
alFailed: That could not be saved. Please retry.
anTruncated: Only part of the data was read, so these numbers are partial.
anCost: Returns are after an assumed round-trip cost of {cost}%.
stFailed: That could not be saved. Please retry.
stNoKinds: No alert types to mute yet.
stAccessHelp: Your tier comes from membership and verified wallet access. Refresh to read it again.
stProfileHelp: How your name and time zone appear across the workspace.
stAppearanceHelp: Theme, density and motion for this browser.
stNotificationsHelp: Choose which alerts reach you. Critical alerts are always delivered.
chNotice: Research only. The assistant reads data and explains it. It cannot place trades or change your settings, and it can be wrong.
chEmpty: Ask a question, for example: which narratives are accelerating right now?

agentUi.welcome: A better question. A clearer perspective.
agentUi.welcomeBody: Explore narratives, understand wallet activity, and challenge a thesis using the research available in your workspace.
agentUi.copyError: Could not copy. Select the reply text to copy it manually.
agentUi.placeholder: Ask about a narrative, token, or tracked wallet…
agentUi.draftRestored: Your question is back in the editor. Review it and send again when ready.

narratives.title: Explore narratives
narratives.description: Find momentum and separate attention from evidence.
narratives.question: Which narratives are accelerating, and what evidence supports their momentum?

wallets.title: Understand wallet activity
wallets.description: Inspect tracked-wallet behavior and sample limitations.
wallets.question: What does recent tracked-wallet activity show, and where is the history incomplete?

risk.title: Challenge a thesis
risk.description: Look for risks, missing data, and reasons to wait.
risk.question: What risks and missing evidence should I check before interpreting the top opportunities?

chNotApplied: Shown for information. Nothing was changed.
